title: Rain Harbour Road: the wet street

subject.summary: Original metre-scale street foundation: two raised pavements, a fourteen-metre carriageway and shallow flush rainwater insets. The reference supplies an approximate wet-night mood, not surveyed dimensions.

Designed thin wearing layer and shallow inset water. All road and water top faces are exactly y=0; no hovering overlays.

Designed central support recess removes coplanar z-fighting: site-ground retains the required 100 x 160 envelope and y=0 top; the street-lower-support carries the road bed within its recess. Front infill closes the approach. Combined support remains continuous.
